title: Lalla-Bubu Crownling
text: A toy-faced breach mascot waddles from the ash in a velvet cape and thorn crown, smiling as its stitched teeth count your fears aloud.
flavor: The first mistake is laughing. The second is letting it hear you stop.

defeatReward.text: You cut the Crownling's charm-chain loose and mark the hollow route it was guarding.
